features.name: Tell Story
features.description: Orchestrates narrative story events, character interactions, quests, and battle mechanics.

diagrams.uml_text:
@startuml
title Feature: Tell Story - Class Diagram
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam roundcorner 5
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
class Enemy {
  - name: String
  + capture(Princess_princess): void
  + guard(Princess_princess): void
}
class Hero {
  - name: String
  + save(Princess_princess): void
  + fight(Enemy_enemy): void
}
class Princess {
  - name: String
  - isCaptured: boolean
  + setCaptured(boolean_captured): void
  + release(): void
  + getName(): String
}
class Story {
  - hero: Hero
  - enemy: Enemy
  - princess: Princess
  + start(): void
  + tell(): void
}
Enemy ..> Princess : capture
Hero ..> Princess : save
Story --> Hero : hero
Story --> Enemy : enemy
Story --> Princess : princess
Story ..> Enemy : start
Story ..> Hero : start
@enduml
diagrams.svg_content:
classDiagram
    %% Feature: Tell Story
    class Enemy {
        +String name
        +capture() void
        +guard() void
    }
    class Hero {
        +String name
        +save() void
        +fight() void
    }
    class Princess {
        +String name
        +boolean isCaptured
        +setCaptured() void
        +release() void
        +getName() String
    }
    class Story {
        +Hero hero
        +Enemy enemy
        +Princess princess
        +start() void
        +tell() void
    }
    Enemy --> Princess
    Hero --> Princess
    Story --> Hero
    Story --> Enemy
    Story --> Princess
    Story --> Enemy
    Story --> Hero

diagrams.uml_text:
@startuml
title Feature: Tell Story - Sequence Diagram
autonumber
participant Enemy
participant Princess
participant Hero
participant Story
Enemy -> Princess: setCaptured()
activate Princess
Princess --> Enemy: return
deactivate Princess
Hero -> Princess: release()
activate Princess
Princess --> Hero: return
deactivate Princess
Story -> Enemy: capture()
activate Enemy
Enemy --> Story: return
deactivate Enemy
Story -> Hero: fight()
activate Hero
Hero --> Story: return
deactivate Hero
Story -> Hero: save()
activate Hero
Hero --> Story: return
deactivate Hero
@enduml
diagrams.svg_content:
sequenceDiagram
    %% Feature: Tell Story
    participant Enemy as "Enemy"
    participant Princess as "Princess"
    participant Hero as "Hero"
    participant Story as "Story"
    Enemy->>+Princess: setCaptured()
    Princess-->>-Enemy: result
    Hero->>+Princess: release()
    Princess-->>-Hero: result
    Story->>+Enemy: capture()
    Enemy-->>-Story: result
    Story->>+Hero: fight()
    Hero-->>-Story: result
    Story->>+Hero: save()
    Hero-->>-Story: result
